chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from Abī Ayyūb, from Ḥumrān, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام:
Regarding a man who kills a slave owned by him, he عليه السلام said: "He must free a slave, fast two consecutive months, and repent to Allah, Mighty and Majestic."

key_terms.رَقَبَةً: a slave to be freed as expiation

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man kills a slave that he owns?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a master who kills his own slave. It requires expiation through freeing a slave, fasting two consecutive months, and turning in repentance to Allah, indicating both legal liability and moral culpability.
